# bash completion for tur -- generated by `tur completion bash`.
#
# Install:
#   tur completion bash > /usr/local/etc/bash_completion.d/tur
# or source it directly from ~/.bashrc:
#   source <(tur completion bash)

__tur_commands="build compile link emit-c emit-h run just repl worker
interpret debug dap trace lsp-lite eval doc docs explain test check expand
format fmt parse-check demangle smt experiments dialects completion init add
add-cmake fetch audit emit-cmake install uninstall list upgrade new
audit-spans lsp mcp image-info image-verify jit"

__tur_global_flags="--help --version --no-color --json --json-diagnostics
--strict-effects -Werror=strict-effects --strict-refine --no-contracts --keep-contracts
--warn-unused-result --panic-abort --no-auto-spice --no-global-spices --enable="

# Recipe names from the enclosing Justfile (empty when there is none).
__tur_recipes() {
    "${COMP_WORDS[0]}" run --list 2>/dev/null | awk 'NF { print $1 }'
}

__tur_turfiles() {
    compgen -f -X '!*.tur' -- "$1"
    compgen -f -X '!*.tur.sweet' -- "$1"
    compgen -d -- "$1"
}

_tur() {
    local cur prev cmd
    cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
    prev="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD-1]}"

    # First non-flag word after the binary is the subcommand.
    local i
    cmd=""
    for (( i=1; i < COMP_CWORD; i++ )); do
        case "${COMP_WORDS[i]}" in
            -*) ;;
            *) cmd="${COMP_WORDS[i]}"; break ;;
        esac
    done

    if [ -z "$cmd" ]; then
        COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "$__tur_commands $__tur_global_flags" -- "$cur") )
        return 0
    fi

    # Flag values that take a path.
    case "$prev" in
        -o|--build-dir|-B|--justfile|--output-dir)
            COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -f -- "$cur") ); return 0 ;;
        --chdir|-I)
            COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -d -- "$cur") ); return 0 ;;
    esac

    case "$cmd" in
        run|just)
            local flags="--list --all --json --dry-run --verbose --justfile
--chdir --init --force --release"
            if [[ "$cur" == -* ]]; then
                COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "$flags" -- "$cur") )
            else
                COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "$(__tur_recipes)" -- "$cur")
                            $(__tur_turfiles "$cur") )
            fi
            ;;
        build)
            if [[ "$cur" == -* ]]; then
                COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "-o --build-dir --release --shared --watch -I" -- "$cur") )
            else
                COMPREPLY=( $(__tur_turfiles "$cur") )
            fi
            ;;
        check|emit-c|emit-h|compile|interpret|debug|parse-check|audit-spans|format|repl)
            COMPREPLY=( $(__tur_turfiles "$cur") )
            ;;
        fmt)
            if [[ "$cur" == -* ]]; then
                COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--check --diff --dry-run" -- "$cur") )
            else
                COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -f -- "$cur") )
            fi
            ;;
        test|init|new)
            COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -d -- "$cur") )
            ;;
        add|add-cmake)
            COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--path --ref --workspace" -- "$cur")
                        $(compgen -d -- "$cur") )
            ;;
        fetch)
            COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--update --dry-run --refetch" -- "$cur") )
            ;;
        install|uninstall|upgrade)
            COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--path --all" -- "$cur")
                        $(compgen -d -- "$cur") )
            ;;
        list)
            COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "--verbose --outdated" -- "$cur") )
            ;;
        completion)
            COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "zsh bash" -- "$cur") )
            ;;
        *)
            COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -f -- "$cur") )
            ;;
    esac
    return 0
}

complete -F _tur tur
[exit 0]
